question: Will these sanctions bite, yes or no?

lines.text: Britain says its sanctions now cover over 90 percent of Russia's oil production capacity.
lines.note: GOV.UK (FCDO): with today's targets, UK sanctions now cover over 90% of Russia's total oil production capacity

lines.text: Today's package adds 38 new targets, the Foreign Office says.
Two more Russian oil companies are hit: Zarubezhneft and INK Capital.
lines.note: GOV.UK (FCDO): Today the UK sanctions two more Russian oil companies: Zarubezhneft and INK Capital.

lines.text: Twelve more shadow fleet tankers are added, taking the UK total past 600 vessels.
lines.note: GOV.UK (FCDO): a further 12 oil tankers ... bringing the total number sanctioned to over 600

lines.text: The UK says these ships are often over 20 years old and can sail under false flags.
lines.note: GOV.UK (FCDO): Shadow fleet vessels are often over 20 years old, engaging in deceptive shipping practices ... and can be sailing under false flags

lines.text: Three crypto exchanges and two payment platforms are targeted, three linked to Kyrgyzstan.
lines.note: GOV.UK (FCDO): three crypto exchanges and two payment platforms, including three linked to Kyrgyzstan and one linked individual

lines.text: Britain says two processed transactions for the Kremlin-backed A7 finance network.
lines.note: GOV.UK (FCDO): two of which have processed and facilitated transactions with the A7 network. The Kremlin-backed A7 illicit finance network

lines.text: The UK says A7 claimed to move more than 90 billion dollars last year.
lines.note: GOV.UK (FCDO): Last year, the network claimed to have moved more than $90 billion

lines.text: Seventeen more are linked to supplying machine tools and electronics for Russia's war effort.
lines.note: GOV.UK (FCDO): 17 entities and individuals involved in the supply of goods ... Russia-based importers of machine tools, electronics and materials

lines.text: Ed Miliband announced the package on his first visit to Ukraine as Foreign Secretary.
lines.note: GOV.UK press release: first visit to Ukraine as Foreign Secretary; unveiled sanctions package during meeting with Zelenskyy

lines.text: His message to Putin: you cannot wait us out.
lines.note: GOV.UK press release: 'My message to Putin is clear – You cannot wait us out.'

lines.text: He also pledged 54 million pounds for Ukraine's winter energy and heating.
lines.note: GOV.UK press release: £54 million in combined energy and humanitarian funding; £20m energy security, £34m heating and water

lines.text: Will these sanctions bite, yes or no?
